comments.text: I never heard of Socotra until today! thanks for this documentary

comments.author: @PrimeTravel2
comments.text: Socotra is one of those places that almost feels like another planet. 🌍 What fascinates me most is how people have adapted their lives to such an isolated environment. I wonder how much daily life has changed there over the years.

replies.author: @BestTravel2
replies.text: It’s truly incredible to see how local communities balance their deep-rooted ancient traditions with the realities of the modern world!

replies.author: @MasonBrooks44
replies.text: It’s so breathtaking how peaceful daily life feels here despite everything happening across the mainland. With all the outside geopolitical interests in the island lately, I really hope their unique culture and resilience stay protected.

comments.author: @CulturalTravel4K
comments.text: If science calls Socotra an alien paradise, everyday reality calls it an endurance test against harsh winds and seasonal isolation. Brilliant documentary work

replies.author: @BestTravel2
replies.text: It’s truly incredible how the people of Socotra maintain such deep-rooted traditions while living in such an isolated and challenging environment!
